title: Attio MCP
snippet:
Attio MCP is Attio’s hosted MCP server that gives AI tools secure access to your Attio workspace. It’s designed to work seamlessly with popular AI assistants like Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and more.
### Why use Attio MCP?
- **Easy setup** — Connect through simple OAuth with one-click installation for supported AI tools
- **Natural language CRM management** — Manage your entire Attio workspace through conversational AI instead of clicking through multiple screens
- **Full workspace access** — AI tools can search, read, create, and update records across your CRM—people, companies, deals, tasks, and notes
- **Optimized for AI** — Built specifically for AI agents with efficient data formatting and human-readable responses
- **Secure by design** — Authenticates as your Attio user with OAuth, and read operations are auto-approved while write operations request confirmation

### Prerequisites
Before connecting Attio MCP, ensure you have:
1. An active Attio workspace
2. An MCP-compatible AI client (Claude Desktop, Claude.ai, ChatGPT, Cursor, etc.)
### Connecting to Attio MCP
Attio MCP uses OAuth authentication, so you simply log in with your Attio account—no API keys required.
#### Add as a Custom Connector
In your AI tool of choice, add the following URL as a custom MCP connector:
```
https://mcp.attio.com/mcp
```
**For Claude Desktop or Claude.ai:**
1. Open Settings -> Connectors -> Browse connectors
2. Search for Attio
3. Install Attio
**For ChatGPT:**
1. Open Apps
2. Search for Attio
3. Connect Attio
**For other MCP clients:** Add `https://mcp.attio.com/mcp` as a remote MCP server and complete the OAuth authentication when prompted. Once connected, you’ll be authenticated as your Attio user with access to your workspace data.

Attio MCP applies per-workspace rate limits to tool calls. Tools are grouped into tiers, and each tier has its own limit. Tools in the same tier share a single bucket per workspace, so calls to any tool in a tier count against the same limit.

> Attio's MCP server connects your CRM to the AI tools your team already has open. Sign in once from ChatGPT, Claude, Notion, or anything else that speaks MCP, then search records, log notes, create tasks, and update deals without switching tabs. Your AI tools can read from Attio and write back to it, over Universal Context — the deepest context layer in agentic CRM — with access scoped to each person and actions verified before they run.
## What is Attio's MCP server?
MCP (Model Context Protocol) is an open standard for connecting AI tools to the systems they need. Attio's MCP server makes your workspace available to any MCP client, so the tool you already have open can read from Attio and write back to it.
It combines three things:
- **Speaks your language.** No views to build, no filters to set. Get insights and take action in conversation.
- **Full workspace access.** Search, create, and update across your CRM records and activities.
- **Secure by design.** Authenticate via OAuth with user-scoped permissions.
The result: your CRM stops being a place you always have to go and becomes something your AI tools can always reach, in every tool your team already works in.

- **471K+** — average MCP calls made from Attio workspaces every day
- **40%** — of Enterprise workspaces use Attio MCP
## Core Capabilities
### Search & Retrieve
- Ask questions about any record, company, or contact in plain language
- Run semantic search across notes, emails, and call recordings
- Pull a full account history before a meeting without opening Attio
### Create & Update
- Update deal stages, values, and next steps as conversations happen
- Log notes against any record the moment a call ends
- Create and update tasks, assign owners, and set due dates
- Create and update records across any object in your workspace
- Build a target list and add records to it as you research.
### Meeting & Call Intelligence
- Search meetings and call recordings by metadata or meaning
- Retrieve a specific call recording or transcript
- Find the conversation where a topic came up, then read exactly what was said
- Build lists of quotes and themes across many recorded conversations
### Research & Analysis
- Surface patterns across accounts rather than one record at a time
- Assemble reports on your interactions with any company
- Extract product feedback and objections from calls at scale
